tagline: Designers don't need more tools. They need better decisions.

scales.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl+ tracking-tighter leading-none font-black uppercase
scales.h2: text-4xl sm:text-5xl tracking-tight leading-none font-extrabold uppercase

visual_motifs.brackets: Oversized { } used as background watermarks, section dividers, or framing elements. Use JetBrains Mono for the braces.
visual_motifs.borders: Exposed 1px solid black grid lines (Grid Borders / The Technical Look) to frame content like an architectural blueprint. border-collapse styles.
visual_motifs.shadows: Sharp, solid 1px or 4px drop shadows (e.g., shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#0A0A0A]) instead of soft blurs.

spacing_and_layout.system: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-8 to p-24 for section padding.
spacing_and_layout.grid: Bento Grid (The 'Tetris' Grid Mode A). Asymmetrical layout, mixing wide and tall structural boxes with visible 1px borders.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Optical alignment, left-aligned heavy text for raw brutalist feel.

buttons.primary: bg-[#0A0A0A] text-white hover:bg-[#0033FF] rounded-none px-6 py-4 font-mono uppercase text-sm tracking-widest transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#0A0A0A] text-[#0A0A0A] hover:bg-[#0A0A0A] hover:text-white rounded-none px-6 py-4 font-mono uppercase text-sm tracking-widest transition-colors

cards.default: bg-white border border-[#0A0A0A] rounded-none shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#0A0A0A] p-8

inputs.default: border-b-2 border-[#0A0A0A] bg-transparent focus:border-[#0033FF] focus:ring-0 rounded-none font-mono text-sm px-0 py-3 placeholder:text-neutral-400

navigation.header: Solid background (#F4F4F0) with a hard 1px bottom border (#0A0A0A). High contrast logo. Monospace nav links.

landing.hero: Asymmetric split layout. Left: Massive 'Cabinet Grotesk' tagline 'DESIGNERS DON\'T NEED MORE TOOLS.' with '{ }' motif overlapping text. Right: Blueprint architectural image with multiply blend mode. Dual CTA.
landing.philosophy: 3-layer horizontal flex or grid timeline (Situation Framing, Context Compression, Decision Engine) connected by a solid 1px horizontal black line.
landing.walkthrough: 5 stark brutalist cards. Minimal text, heavy use of mono fonts for labels (e.g., '01. FRAMING').
landing.artifacts: Overlapping artifact examples styled as physical paper documents with stark borders.
landing.pricing: 3 columns. Free / Pro / Studio. The 'Studio' tier uses black background (#0A0A0A) with white text and electric blue accent. Currency toggle styled as a mechanical switch.

dashboard.layout: The 'Control Room' Grid Mode B. Dense, data-heavy, 1px border grid system (border-collapse).
dashboard.sections: Active Projects list, Decisions in Progress, Locked Decisions.
dashboard.styling: Cardless layout where possible, using borders to separate widgets.

new_project_flow.layout: 5-step wizard. Progress indicator is a stark line filling with #0033FF. Steps are separated by literal bracket motifs '{' and '}'. Content area is a focused, minimal terminal-like interface for intent capture.

image_urls.description: Abstract architectural curves and lines, used with a multiply blend mode to look like a blueprint sketch.
Technical architectural drawing for the 3-layer philosophy section.
Minimalist designer desk setup for the Artifacts and Dashboard context.
Minimalist editorial typography poster for Case Studies section.

accessibility_and_interactions.hover: Hover states must invert colors (e.g. black to blue) or shift position (-translate-y-1). Do not rely solely on opacity changes.
accessibility_and_interactions.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute using kebab-case role-based names.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Cabinet Grotesk (from Fontshare) or fallback to Oswald, Manrope (Google Fonts), and JetBrains Mono.
Implement pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing layouts to achieve the 1px grid border ('border-collapse' style) and sharp brutalist aesthetic.
Do NOT use rounded corners on cards, buttons, or inputs (use 'rounded-none').
Do NOT use soft shadows; use solid harsh shadows like 'shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#0A0A0A]'.
Liberally use the characters '{' and '}' as decorative text elements with a large font size and low opacity, or as structural dividers.
Prioritize optical alignment over strict geometric alignment for typography.
For the App/Dashboard, use heavily customized Shadcn components (strip out all border-radius and default soft shadows to match the Brutalist aesthetic).
